stem:
A horse trainer records the distance a horse travels during three different trials.

Horse’s Traveling Times and Distances

| Trial | Time (minutes) | Distance (kilometers) |
|-------|----------------|----------------------|
| 1     | 15             | 4.5                  |
| 2     | 30             | 9.0                  |
| 3     | 45             | 13.5                 |

What is the horse’s average speed in kilometers per minute?
visual_elements: table with data on trial number, time in minutes, and distance in kilometers
